outcome: need for blood transfusion (>=4 blood products)
need for intensive care unit (ICU) admission
cohort: 100 randomly selected patients who delivered after 28 weeks with visual blood loss greater than 500 mL in normal vaginal delivery and greater than 1000 mL during lower segment cesarean section.
finding: A shock index greater than 1 was associated with the need for operative intervention, greater than 1.3 with ICU admission and massive blood transfusion, and greater than 1.6 with mortality; the shock index had the highest AUROC compared to MAP and HR for predicting these outcomes.
